correctness.rationale: Complete Rule-22 edge tables imply a 3-cycle for output 1 and five output-0 transitions. Nonadjacent output zeros impose the two-state 3-residue partial-permutation product, whose trace exactly counts fixed-ring predecessors. Formal trace-log enumerates indexed outputs with weights n/m, with precisely the even all-residue-2 double fibers subtracted. The determinant identity and coefficient extraction prove the all-n formula; the archived standalone direct enumerator independently checks all input/output fibers through n=17 and rational coefficients through n=120. Boundary n=1,2 and all-ones cases are explicit. Enumeration is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: There is a motivated information-theoretic and symbolic-dynamics question: how much of the natural high-density cyclic 00-avoiding output codebook lies in the one-step image of Rule22, and how ambiguous are inverse fibers? The answer supplies a complete fixed-period reachability and 0/1/2 fiber classification, a closed nontrivial all-length distinct-image formula and an exact entropy gap relative to Fibonacci growth. These precise quantities are not routine boundary substitutions, despite the standard de Bruijn methodology and earlier knowledge of the same spectral constant.
